name: sidebar
blurb: Collapsible sidebar with context provider and smooth open/close animations.
description: Context-based sidebar system with SidebarProvider, Sidebar, SidebarBody, DesktopSidebar, MobileSidebar, and SidebarLink components. Uses Framer Motion for smooth collapse/expand and provides a custom hook for managing open state.
use_when: Creating responsive layouts with collapsible navigation that works across desktop and mobile viewports with animation.
avoid_when: Simple, non-collapsible layouts. Overkill for single-level navigation structures.
a11y: Mobile menu button lacks ARIA attributes. Keyboard navigation not built-in. Focus management should be handled by parent.
